_meta.description: DXPR Theme settings schema. Auto-generated from features/*-theme-settings.inc files.

fields.type: Value type: boolean, range, radios, select, textfield, textarea, checkboxes, font, color, theme_color, media, path, serialized_palette
fields.title: Short human label (shown in GUI)
fields.ai_description: Design-oriented guidance for AI agents: visual effects, value ranges for different styles, relationships
fields.unit: CSS unit (px, %, em) for range type

block_preset.title: Block Design Preset
block_preset.ai_description: Quick-apply design preset for sidebar blocks and widget areas. (empty)=theme defaults. block_boxed=white boxes with shadow. block_outline=bordered blocks. block_card=Bootstrap card style. title_inverted=dark title bar. title_sticker=compact title. default_divider=title with divider. custom=full manual control.

block_card.title: Block Card Style
block_card.ai_description: Bootstrap card class applied to blocks. (empty)=no card. card card-body=default white card. bg-primary=primary color card. Use accent variants for colored sidebar sections. Overrides block_padding, block_border when set.

block_background.title: Block Background
block_background.ai_description: Background color for blocks (when not using block_card). Creates colored block containers. Use a theme palette color or custom.

block_background_custom.title: Custom Value
block_background_custom.ai_description: Custom hex for block background. Only used when block_background=custom. Light grays (#f5f5f5, #f8f9fa) create subtle card-like blocks.

block_padding.title: Block Padding
block_padding.ai_description: Internal padding inside blocks. 0=no padding. 10-15px=compact. 20-30px=comfortable. Disabled when block_card is set.

block_border_radius.title: Block Border Radius
block_border_radius.ai_description: Rounded corners on blocks. 0=sharp corners (corporate). 4-8px=subtle rounding (modern standard). 12-20px=noticeably rounded (friendly). Disabled when block_card is set.

block_border.title: Block Border
block_border.ai_description: Border width around blocks. 0=no border. 1px=subtle outline. 2-3px=visible frame. Disabled when block_card is set.

block_border_color.title: Block Border Color
block_border_color.ai_description: Color of the block border. Often a light gray (#dee2e6) for subtle definition. Only visible when block_border>0.

block_border_color_custom.title: Custom Value
block_border_color_custom.ai_description: Custom hex for block border. Only used when block_border_color=custom.

title_font_size.title: Title Font Size
title_font_size.ai_description: Heading level for block titles. h2=large section heading. h3=standard block title (default). h4=smaller heading. body=paragraph-sized (subtle).

title_align.title: Title Align
title_align.ai_description: Block title text alignment. left=standard (default). center=formal/symmetrical. right=unconventional.

title_card.title: Title Card Style
title_card.ai_description: Bootstrap card styling on the title element separately from the block body. Creates a highlighted title bar.

title_background.title: Title Background
title_background.ai_description: Background color for block titles. Creates colored title bars. Combined with contrasting text creates the inverted title look.

title_background_custom.title: Custom Value
title_background_custom.ai_description: Custom hex for title background. Only used when title_background=custom.

title_padding.title: Title Padding
title_padding.ai_description: Padding inside the title element. 5-10px=compact. 15-20px=comfortable. 25-30px=spacious title bar. Disabled when title_card is set.

title_border.title: Title Border
title_border.ai_description: Border width on block titles. 0=no border. 1-2px=subtle underline/frame. 3+px=bold accent.

title_border_radius.title: Title Border Radius
title_border_radius.ai_description: Rounded corners on the title element. 0=sharp. 4-8px=subtle.

title_border_color.title: Title Border Color
title_border_color.ai_description: Color of the title border. Often an accent color for decorative emphasis.

title_border_color_custom.title: Custom Value
title_border_color_custom.ai_description: Custom hex for title border. Only used when title_border_color=custom.

title_sticker.title: Title Sticker Mode
title_sticker.ai_description: When enabled, title element shrinks to fit its text content instead of spanning full block width. Creates compact modern title label. Works well with title_background. Overrides title_align.

block_divider.title: Add Divider to Block
block_divider.ai_description: Add a horizontal divider line between block title and content. Creates clean visual separation. Popular in minimal/editorial designs.

block_divider_custom.title: Customize Divider
block_divider_custom.description: Override the global divider styles from the Typography tab for this block only.
block_divider_custom.ai_description: Enable to override global divider settings with block-specific divider styling. Disable to inherit global divider_thickness/length/color.

block_divider_color.title: Divider Color
block_divider_color.ai_description: Color for block-specific divider. Only active when block_divider=true and block_divider_custom=true.

block_divider_color_custom.title: Custom Value
block_divider_color_custom.ai_description: Custom hex for block divider. Only used when block_divider_color=custom.

block_divider_thickness.title: Divider Thickness
block_divider_thickness.ai_description: Thickness of block dividers. 1-2px=hairline. 3-4px=standard. Only active when block_divider=true and block_divider_custom=true.

block_divider_length.title: Divider Length
block_divider_length.ai_description: Width of block dividers. 0=full width. Short lengths (30-80px) create accent marks. Only active when block_divider=true and block_divider_custom=true.

block_divider_spacing.title: Divider Spacing
block_divider_spacing.ai_description: Vertical space above and below the block divider. 10-15px=tight. 20px=standard. 30+px=generous. Only active when block_divider=true and block_divider_custom=true.

block_design_regions.title: Regions
block_design_regions.ai_description: Select which theme regions these block design settings apply to. Common choices: sidebar_first, sidebar_second (sidebar widgets), footer (footer blocks), content (main content blocks).

color_scheme.title: Color Set
color_scheme.ai_description: Select a predefined color scheme or custom to define individual palette colors. Available schemes are defined in the theme's color-settings.json. Use dxt:generate:palette to create a scheme from a natural language description.

custom_css_site.title: Sitewide CSS
custom_css_site.ai_description: Raw CSS code injected on every page. Use for quick overrides without creating a subtheme. Avoid duplicating what theme settings already control.

custom_javascript_site.title: Sitewide JavaScript
custom_javascript_site.ai_description: Raw JavaScript code injected on every page. Use for tracking snippets, custom interactions, or third-party widget initialization. Runs after DOM ready.

body_font_face.title: Base Font
body_font_face.ai_description: Primary font for all body/paragraph text. Sets the overall reading experience. Web-safe options: helvetica (clean modern), georgia (elegant serif), verdana (screen-optimized). Google fonts: 0Roboto:400 (versatile), 0Open+Sans:400 (friendly), 0Lato:400 (professional). Format: web-safe name or 0FontName:weight.

body_font_face_selector.title: CSS Selector
body_font_face_selector.ai_description: CSS selector where the body font applies. Default body covers everything. Rarely needs changing unless you want body font only on specific elements.

headings_font_face.title: Headings
headings_font_face.ai_description: Font for all headings (h1-h6). Creates visual hierarchy contrast with body font. Classic pairings: serif headings + sans body (0Playfair+Display:700 + Roboto). Same family different weight. Display fonts add personality (0Montserrat:700, 0Poppins:600).

headings_font_face_selector.title: CSS Selector
headings_font_face_selector.ai_description: CSS selector for headings font. Default covers h1-h6, display classes, labels, and page title. Extend to add custom heading classes.

nav_font_face.title: Navigation
nav_font_face.ai_description: Font for main navigation links. Often matches headings_font_face or body_font_face. Sans-serif fonts work best for navigation readability at small sizes.

nav_font_face_selector.title: CSS Selector
nav_font_face_selector.ai_description: CSS selector for navigation font. Default .dxpr-theme-header .nav targets the main menu.

sitename_font_face.title: Site Name
sitename_font_face.ai_description: Font for the site name/brand text in the header. Can be a distinctive display or logo font. Choose something that represents the brand identity.

sitename_font_face_selector.title: CSS Selector
sitename_font_face_selector.ai_description: CSS selector for site name font. Default covers .site-name and .navbar-brand.

blockquote_font_face.title: Blockquote
blockquote_font_face.ai_description: Font for blockquote/pullquote elements. Often an italic serif for literary feel: 0Merriweather:italic, 0Lora:italic. Can match body font for consistency or contrast for emphasis.

blockquote_font_face_selector.title: CSS Selector
blockquote_font_face_selector.ai_description: CSS selector for blockquote font. Default covers blockquote and blockquote p elements.

header_top_layout.title: Layout
header_top_layout.ai_description: Visual arrangement of logo and navigation. 0=logo left, menu right (standard business/corporate, most versatile). centered=logo stacked above centered menu (boutique, restaurant, elegant). centered_inline=logo centered between split menu halves (fashion, luxury). logo_left_menu_left=both left-aligned (editorial, news). logo_center_menu_left=logo centered, menu left (portfolio). logo_center_menu_right=logo centered, menu right (portfolio variant). logo_right_menu_left=logo right, menu left (RTL-friendly, unconventional).

header_style.title: Header Style
header_style.description: Overlay mode places the header over page content, allowing transparent backgrounds.
header_style.ai_description: normal=standard header with its own background band above page content. overlay=header floats transparently over page content (hero images show through). Overlay is dramatic for landing pages with hero images; pair with reduced header_top_bg_opacity for glass effect.

header_top_bg_opacity.title: Header Opacity
header_top_bg_opacity.ai_description: Header background transparency. 1=fully opaque (solid). 0.8-0.95=subtle transparency (glass/frosted effect). 0.5=semi-transparent (content visible behind). 0=fully transparent (header floats invisibly). Best combined with header_style=overlay for hero sections.

header_top_height.title: Height
header_top_height.ai_description: Header height controls visual prominence. 60-80px=compact modern header (SaaS, tech). 100px=standard balanced. 120-150px=tall prominent header (luxury, portfolio). 150-200px=very tall statement header. Pairs with logo_height percentage.

logo_height.title: Logo Height
logo_height.description: Logo height as percentage of the header height.
logo_height.ai_description: Logo height as percentage of header height. 50%=logo uses half the header (balanced). 70-80%=logo dominates header (brand-focused). 30-40%=subtle small logo (minimalist). Actual pixel height = header_top_height x logo_height/100.

header_top_fixed.title: Fixed Position
header_top_fixed.description: Header stays visible at the top when scrolling.
header_top_fixed.ai_description: Enable to keep header always visible at top of viewport while scrolling. Essential for sites with important navigation. Disable for content-focused reading experiences (blogs, articles) where you want maximum content space.

header_top_sticky.title: Sticky Header
header_top_sticky.description: Header appears after scrolling past a specified offset.
header_top_sticky.ai_description: Requires header_top_fixed=true. When enabled, header shrinks/transforms after scrolling past header_top_height_sticky_offset. Creates a compact navigation that appears on scroll, a common modern UX pattern. Configure the smaller size with header_top_height_scroll.

second_header_sticky.title: Sticky Second Header
second_header_sticky.ai_description: Makes the secondary header bar also stick when scrolling. Only relevant when header_style=overlay and header_top_sticky=true. Usually disabled to keep sticky header compact.

header_top_sticky_show.title: Hide before Scrolling
header_top_sticky_show.description: Use Overlay mode to prevent empty space at the top when hidden initially.
header_top_sticky_show.ai_description: always=sticky header always visible as you scroll. after_scroll=header hides initially and only appears after scrolling down (saves space, reveals on intent). The after_scroll pattern is popular on mobile-first and content-heavy sites.

options.after_scroll: Hide initially. Show after scroll offset

header_top_height_sticky_offset.title: Scroll offset
header_top_height_sticky_offset.description: Scroll distance before header becomes fixed.
header_top_height_sticky_offset.ai_description: How far user must scroll (in px) before sticky header appears. 60px=appears quickly. 200-400px=appears after scrolling past hero section. Match to your hero/banner height for smooth transition.

header_top_height_scroll.title: Height
header_top_height_scroll.description: Header height after scrolling past scroll offset.
header_top_height_scroll.ai_description: Height of the header after it enters sticky mode. Usually smaller than header_top_height for a compact scrolled state. 40-60px=compact. 70-90px=moderate. Common pattern: header_top_height=100, header_top_height_scroll=60.

header_top_bg_opacity_scroll.title: Background Opacity
header_top_bg_opacity_scroll.ai_description: Background opacity after entering sticky mode. Usually 1 (fully opaque) so sticky header is readable against any content. Set to 0.9-0.95 for subtle glass effect in sticky state.

navbar_background.title: Navbar Background
navbar_background.ai_description: Background color for the entire navbar area. Use a theme palette color name or custom with navbar_background_custom. Leave empty for transparent. Dark backgrounds create dramatic headers; light/white creates clean modern feel.

navbar_background_custom.title: Custom Navbar Background
navbar_background_custom.ai_description: Custom hex color for navbar background. Only used when navbar_background=custom. Set to match your brand color for branded headers.

navbar_text_color.title: Navbar Text
navbar_text_color.ai_description: Text/link color in the navbar. Must contrast with navbar_background for readability. Light text on dark backgrounds, dark text on light backgrounds.

navbar_text_color_custom.title: Custom Navbar Text Color
navbar_text_color_custom.ai_description: Custom hex color for navbar text. Only used when navbar_text_color=custom.

header_block_background.title: Block Background
header_block_background.ai_description: Background color for blocks placed in the header region (search, contact info, etc.). Often matches navbar_background or uses a complementary color.

header_block_background_custom.title: Custom Block Background
header_block_background_custom.ai_description: Custom hex color for header block background. Only used when header_block_background=custom.

header_block_text_color.title: Block Text
header_block_text_color.ai_description: Text color in header blocks. Must contrast with header_block_background.

header_block_text_color_custom.title: Custom Block Text Color
header_block_text_color_custom.ai_description: Custom hex color for header block text. Only used when header_block_text_color=custom.

menu_background.title: Menu Background
menu_background.ai_description: Background color specifically for the main navigation menu area. Often transparent (empty) to inherit from navbar, or a distinct color to visually separate menu from rest of header.

menu_background_custom.title: Custom Menu Background
menu_background_custom.ai_description: Custom hex for menu background. Only used when menu_background=custom.

menu_text_color.title: Menu Text
menu_text_color.ai_description: Color of main menu link text. Should contrast with menu_background (or navbar_background if menu_background is empty).

menu_text_color_custom.title: Custom Menu Text Color
menu_text_color_custom.ai_description: Custom hex for menu text. Only used when menu_text_color=custom.

menu_hover_background.title: Menu Hover Background
menu_hover_background.ai_description: Background color that appears when hovering over a menu item. Creates visual feedback. Use a slightly lighter/darker shade of menu_background, or an accent color for emphasis.

menu_hover_background_custom.title: Custom Menu Hover Background
menu_hover_background_custom.ai_description: Custom hex for menu hover background. Only used when menu_hover_background=custom.

menu_hover_text_color.title: Menu Hover Text
menu_hover_text_color.ai_description: Text color of menu items on hover. Often an accent/brand color to highlight the active item.

menu_hover_text_color_custom.title: Custom Menu Hover Text Color
menu_hover_text_color_custom.ai_description: Custom hex for menu hover text. Only used when menu_hover_text_color=custom.

dropdown_background.title: Dropdown Background
dropdown_background.ai_description: Background color of dropdown/submenu panels. Usually white or light gray for readability. Dark dropdowns work on dark-themed sites.

dropdown_background_custom.title: Custom Dropdown Background
dropdown_background_custom.ai_description: Custom hex for dropdown background. Only used when dropdown_background=custom.

dropdown_text_color.title: Dropdown Text
dropdown_text_color.ai_description: Text color inside dropdown menus. Must contrast with dropdown_background.

dropdown_text_color_custom.title: Custom Dropdown Text Color
dropdown_text_color_custom.ai_description: Custom hex for dropdown text. Only used when dropdown_text_color=custom.

dropdown_hover_background.title: Dropdown Hover Background
dropdown_hover_background.ai_description: Background color when hovering over dropdown items. Subtle shade change (e.g., #f5f5f5 on white) provides feedback.

dropdown_hover_background_custom.title: Custom Dropdown Hover Background
dropdown_hover_background_custom.ai_description: Custom hex for dropdown hover background. Only used when dropdown_hover_background=custom.

dropdown_hover_text_color.title: Dropdown Hover Text
dropdown_hover_text_color.ai_description: Text color of dropdown items on hover. Often matches brand/accent color.

dropdown_hover_text_color_custom.title: Custom Dropdown Hover Text Color
dropdown_hover_text_color_custom.ai_description: Custom hex for dropdown hover text. Only used when dropdown_hover_text_color=custom.

mobile_menu_background.title: Mobile Menu Background
mobile_menu_background.ai_description: Background color of the mobile hamburger menu panel. Usually matches the site header color or uses a dark overlay. Ensure good contrast with mobile_menu_text_color.

mobile_menu_background_custom.title: Custom Mobile Menu Background
mobile_menu_background_custom.ai_description: Custom hex for mobile menu background. Only used when mobile_menu_background=custom.

mobile_menu_text_color.title: Mobile Menu Text
mobile_menu_text_color.ai_description: Text color of links in the mobile menu. Must be clearly readable against mobile_menu_background.

mobile_menu_text_color_custom.title: Custom Mobile Menu Text Color
mobile_menu_text_color_custom.ai_description: Custom hex for mobile menu text. Only used when mobile_menu_text_color=custom.

mobile_menu_hover_background.title: Mobile Menu Hover Background
mobile_menu_hover_background.ai_description: Background color when tapping/hovering mobile menu items. Provides touch feedback.

mobile_menu_hover_background_custom.title: Custom Mobile Menu Hover Background
mobile_menu_hover_background_custom.ai_description: Custom hex for mobile menu hover background. Only used when mobile_menu_hover_background=custom.

mobile_menu_hover_text_color.title: Mobile Menu Hover Text
mobile_menu_hover_text_color.ai_description: Text color of mobile menu items on hover/tap.

mobile_menu_hover_text_color_custom.title: Custom Mobile Menu Hover Text Color
mobile_menu_hover_text_color_custom.ai_description: Custom hex for mobile menu hover text. Only used when mobile_menu_hover_text_color=custom.

hamburger_menu.title: Hamburger Icon Style
hamburger_menu.ai_description: Mobile menu toggle icon style. three-dash=classic three-line hamburger (universally recognized). two-dash=minimal two-line variant (modern, slightly less recognizable).

hamburger_animation.title: Hamburger Animation
hamburger_animation.ai_description: Animation when the hamburger icon is tapped. none=static icon. cross=lines animate into an X when menu opens (polished, signals close). Cross animation is the modern standard.

header_side_align.title: Mobile Menu Alignment
header_side_align.ai_description: Horizontal alignment of the mobile menu panel. left=slides in from left (most common). center=drops down centered. right=slides in from right (matches right-aligned hamburger icon).

dropdown_width_auto.title: Dropdown Width
dropdown_width_auto.ai_description: 1=dropdown menus auto-size to fit their content (clean, adapts to link length). 0=all dropdowns use a fixed width (dropdown_width) for uniform appearance. Auto is usually better unless you need strict visual alignment.

dropdown_width.title: Fixed Dropdown Width
dropdown_width.ai_description: Fixed pixel width for dropdown menus when dropdown_width_auto=0. 200px=compact. 250-300px=standard. 400+px=wide mega-menu style. Only applies when dropdown_width_auto=0.

menu_type.title: Font Style
menu_type.ai_description: Font treatment for main menu links. (empty)=normal text. uppercase=ALL CAPS (strong, authoritative, suits corporate/tech). bold=heavier weight (prominent nav). lead=larger text (statement navigation). Uppercase + border hover creates a sophisticated nav pattern.

menu_link_spacing.title: Link Spacing
menu_link_spacing.description: Horizontal padding between menu links (in pixels).
menu_link_spacing.ai_description: Horizontal padding between menu items. 5-10px=compact/dense navigation (many items). 15-20px=balanced spacing. 25-40px=airy spacing (few menu items, luxury feel). 50px=very spread out.

menu_hover.title: Hover Style
menu_hover.ai_description: Visual feedback style when hovering over menu items. opacity=subtle fade (minimal, modern). background=colored fill behind item (corporate, clear). text=only text color changes (subtle). border=underline/overline effect (modern, editorial). Border hover is most popular in contemporary web design; configure with menu_border_* settings.

menu_border_position.title: Hover Style
menu_border_position.ai_description: Position of the hover border line. bottom=underline (most common, modern). top=overline (distinctive, less common). Only applies when menu_hover=border.

menu_border_animate.title: Animation
menu_border_animate.ai_description: Animation for the hover border appearance. (empty)=instant appear. ltr=slides in from left. rtl=slides in from right. middle=expands from center outward (most popular). drop=fades down from top. The middle animation is the most refined and widely used.

menu_border_position_offset.title: Position Offset
menu_border_position_offset.ai_description: Distance in px between the border and the menu item edge. 0=border touches the item. 5-15px=slight gap for floating effect. Adjust to align with header design.

menu_border_position_offset_sticky.title: Position Offset for Sticky Header
menu_border_position_offset_sticky.ai_description: Border offset specifically for sticky header state. Often different from normal offset because sticky header has different height. Only visible when header_top_fixed and header_top_sticky are enabled.

menu_border_size.title: Border Thickness
menu_border_size.ai_description: Thickness of the hover border in pixels. 1-2px=subtle hairline (elegant). 3-4px=visible accent line (balanced). 5+px=bold statement border. 2-3px is most common.

menu_border_color.title: Border Color
menu_border_color.ai_description: Color of the menu hover border. Usually matches the primary/accent color from the color palette. Use a theme palette color name or custom with menu_border_color_custom.

menu_border_color_custom.title: Custom Value
menu_border_color_custom.ai_description: Custom hex for menu border color. Only used when menu_border_color=custom.

header_mobile_breakpoint.title: Mobile Breakpoint
header_mobile_breakpoint.description: Viewport width below which mobile header is used. Set to maximum (4100) to always use mobile style.
header_mobile_breakpoint.ai_description: Viewport width (px) at which desktop header switches to mobile hamburger menu. 992px=tablet breakpoint (shows mobile menu on tablets). 1200px=standard (default, desktop-first). 768px=only phones get mobile menu. Set based on how many menu items fit comfortably.

header_mobile_height.title: Height
header_mobile_height.description: Height of header in mobile view.
header_mobile_height.ai_description: Height of the header on mobile devices. 50-60px=compact (maximizes content space). 70-80px=comfortable with adequate tap targets. Keep smaller than desktop header_top_height.

header_mobile_fixed.title: Fixed Position
header_mobile_fixed.description: Header stays visible at the top when scrolling.
header_mobile_fixed.ai_description: Fix mobile header to top of screen while scrolling. Enable for important navigation on mobile. Disable for content-reading experiences where screen real estate matters.

boxed_layout.title: Boxed Layout
boxed_layout.description: When enabled, all container backgrounds are constrained to a centered column instead of spanning full width.
boxed_layout.ai_description: Controls whether page backgrounds span full viewport or are contained in a centered column. 0 (off)=full-bleed backgrounds spanning entire browser width, modern and immersive, preferred for contemporary SaaS/portfolio/agency sites. 1 (on)=backgrounds constrained to centered box with visible page margins, traditional corporate/blog feel. Most modern designs use 0.

sticky_footer.title: Sticky Footer
sticky_footer.description: Keeps the footer at the bottom of the viewport on short pages. Not compatible with boxed layout.
sticky_footer.ai_description: Prevents footer from floating mid-page when content is shorter than viewport. Enable (1) for most sites. Only relevant when boxed_layout is disabled (0).

boxed_layout_boxbg.title: Box Background
boxed_layout_boxbg.description: Background color for the main content area in boxed mode.
boxed_layout_boxbg.ai_description: Background color visible behind the centered content box when boxed_layout=1. Usually white (#ffffff) or very light gray (#f8f9fa). Only visible when boxed_layout is enabled.

box_max_width.title: Boxed Container Max-width
box_max_width.description: Maximum width of the boxed layout container. Set this higher than the content max-width.
box_max_width.ai_description: Maximum width of the boxed container. 1170px is Bootstrap default. 960-1170px for traditional readability, 1400-1600px for modern widescreen layouts. Only applies when boxed_layout=1.

layout_max_width.title: Content Max-width
layout_max_width.description: Maximum width of the main content container. Default is 1170px.
layout_max_width.ai_description: Maximum width of the main content container. Controls how wide content stretches on large screens. 1170px=Bootstrap default (traditional). 1400-1600px=modern widescreen. 960px=narrow focused reading. Wider values suit image-heavy portfolio/agency sites.

gutter_horizontal.title: Column Spacing
gutter_horizontal.description: Horizontal space between columns. Default is 20px.
gutter_horizontal.ai_description: Space between Bootstrap grid columns. 15-20px=dense content-heavy layouts (news, dashboards). 30-40px=balanced modern designs. 50+px=airy luxury/portfolio spacing with lots of whitespace.

gutter_vertical.title: Row Spacing
gutter_vertical.description: Vertical space between rows. Default is 0.
gutter_vertical.ai_description: Vertical space between grid rows. 0=rows touch (default, spacing managed by content). 10-20px=subtle separation. 30+px=strong visual separation between row elements.

gutter_container.title: Container Padding
gutter_container.description: Horizontal padding inside the container. Default is 30px.
gutter_container.ai_description: Horizontal padding inside the main container, i.e. the breathing room between content and viewport edge. 15-20px=compact. 30px=standard. 50+px=generous whitespace for luxury/editorial feel.

background_image_path.title: Background Image Path
background_image_path.description: Path to the background image file. This field is automatically populated when you upload an image below.
background_image_path.ai_description: File path to the site-wide body background image. Set via media upload or direct path. Common for textured backgrounds (paper, fabric) or subtle patterns.

background_image.title: Upload Background Image
background_image.description: Upload a default background image. You can override this per node using the Header Image field.
background_image.ai_description: Upload a site-wide body background image. Creates a textured or photographic backdrop behind all page content. Can be overridden per-node.

background_image_style.title: Background Size
background_image_style.ai_description: How the background image fills the viewport. cover=fills entire area, crops to fit (best for photos). contain=shows full image, may leave gaps. no_repeat=actual pixel size. repeat=tiles the image (best for patterns/textures).

background_image_position.title: Background Position
background_image_position.ai_description: Anchor point for the background image. center_center=safe default for most images. left_top=align to top-left (logos, patterns). Adjust based on the image focal point.

background_image_attachment.title: Background Scroll Behavior
background_image_attachment.ai_description: scroll=background moves with page content (natural feel). fixed=background stays still while content scrolls over it (parallax effect, dramatic but can cause performance issues on mobile).

gutter_horizontal_mobile.title: Column Spacing
gutter_horizontal_mobile.description: Horizontal space between columns on viewports under 1200px. Default is 10px.
gutter_horizontal_mobile.ai_description: Column spacing on mobile (below header_mobile_breakpoint). Usually smaller than desktop gutter_horizontal. 5-10px=tight mobile layout. 15-20px=comfortable mobile spacing.

gutter_vertical_mobile.title: Row Spacing
gutter_vertical_mobile.description: Vertical space between rows on viewports under 1200px. Default is 0.
gutter_vertical_mobile.ai_description: Row spacing on mobile devices. Same logic as gutter_vertical but for smaller screens.

gutter_container_mobile.title: Container Padding
gutter_container_mobile.description: Horizontal padding inside the container on viewports under 1200px. Default is 20px.
gutter_container_mobile.ai_description: Container padding on mobile. 10-15px=maximizes content width on small screens. 20px=comfortable default. Keep smaller than desktop gutter_container.

secondary_header_hide.title: Hide on Small Devices
secondary_header_hide.ai_description: Controls when the secondary header (top bar with contact info, social links, etc.) hides on smaller screens. hidden_none=always visible. hidden_xs=hide on phones (<768px). hidden_sm=hide on tablets (<992px). hidden_md=hide below desktop (<1200px). Hide early if secondary header is not critical to mobile UX.

full_width_containers.title: Full Width Regions
full_width_containers.description: Select regions that should span the full browser width. Useful for full-width blocks or full-screen backgrounds.
full_width_containers.ai_description: Select regions whose backgrounds span the full browser width (edge-to-edge). Enable for regions where you want full-bleed color sections or hero images. Most modern designs enable this for all regions. Requires boxed_layout=0 to have visual effect.

full_width_content_types.title: Full Width Content Types
full_width_content_types.description: Enable full-width sections for these content types. Only works on pages without sidebars.
full_width_content_types.ai_description: Enable full-width content regions for specific content types. Only effective on pages without sidebars. Useful for landing pages and portfolio content types.

hidden_regions.title: Hidden Regions
hidden_regions.description: Selected regions will be hidden site-wide.
hidden_regions.ai_description: Permanently hide theme regions site-wide. Useful for simplifying layouts, e.g. hide sidebar_first and sidebar_second for a single-column design, hide page_title for a minimal look, hide secondary_header if not using a top bar.

page_title_breadcrumbs.title: Show Breadcrumbs
page_title_breadcrumbs.ai_description: Show breadcrumb navigation trail (Home > Section > Page) in the page title region. Enable for deep content hierarchies (documentation, e-commerce). Disable for flat sites or landing pages.

page_title_breadcrumbs_align.title: Align Breadcrumbs
page_title_breadcrumbs_align.ai_description: Horizontal alignment of breadcrumbs. right=out of the way, doesn't compete with title (default). left=prominent, guides navigation. center=balanced, works with centered titles.

page_title_breadcrumbs_separator.title: Breadcrumbs Separator
page_title_breadcrumbs_separator.ai_description: Character between breadcrumb items. /=clean slash (default). >=arrow style. |=pipe separator. »=guillemet (European style). ·=middle dot (minimal).

page_title_home_hide.title: Hide on Homepage
page_title_home_hide.ai_description: Hide the page title region on the homepage. Enable (1) when your homepage has its own hero/banner to avoid a redundant Home title. Disable (0) if homepage needs the title region for branding.

page_title_align.title: Align Title
page_title_align.ai_description: Page title text alignment. left=standard editorial/corporate. center=formal, symmetrical (works well with centered header). right=unconventional, rarely used.

title_type.title: Font Style
title_type.ai_description: Font style modifiers for the page title (can combine multiple). uppercase=ALL CAPS (authoritative, corporate). bold=heavier weight. italic=elegant emphasis. Common combo: uppercase+bold for strong headings.

page_title_height.title: Height
page_title_height.description: Height of the page title area.
page_title_height.ai_description: Height of the page title banner region. 80-100px=compact (subtitle or minimal title). 120-150px=standard. 200-300px=tall banner (pairs well with background image). 400-500px=hero-style page title.

page_title_animate.title: Animation
page_title_animate.ai_description: Entrance animation when the page title appears on load. 0=no animation (clean, professional). fade-in-dxpr=gentle fade (subtle). bounce-in-down-dxpr=bounces into view (playful). fade-in-up-dxpr=slides up and fades in (modern). Use sparingly; no animation is often most professional.

page_title_image_path.title: Background Image Path
page_title_image_path.description: Automatically populated when you upload an image below.
page_title_image_path.ai_description: File path to the page title background image. Creates a banner/hero effect behind the page title text. Can be overridden per node with field_dth_page_title_backgrou.

page_title_image.title: Upload Background Image
page_title_image.description: Override per node using the Header Image field.
page_title_image.ai_description: Upload a background image for the page title region. Creates a visual banner behind the title text. Larger, taller page_title_height values showcase the image better.

page_title_image_opacity.title: Background Image Opacity
page_title_image_opacity.description: Blend the background image with the background color. 0 = transparent, 1 = opaque.
page_title_image_opacity.ai_description: Opacity of the page title background image. 1=full intensity. 0.3-0.5=subtle watermark behind title text. 0.6-0.8=visible but doesn't overpower text. Lower opacity improves text readability over busy images.

page_title_image_style.title: Background Size
page_title_image_style.ai_description: How the page title background image fills the region. cover=fills entire region, crops to fit (best for photos, most common). contain=shows full image. no_repeat=actual size. repeat=tiles (patterns).

page_title_image_mode.title: Background Scroll Behavior
page_title_image_mode.ai_description: Scroll behavior of page title background. normal=scrolls with page (natural). fixed=stays still while content scrolls (parallax effect, dramatic for tall page titles).

page_title_image_position.title: Background Position
page_title_image_position.ai_description: Anchor point for the page title background image. center_center=safe default. Adjust based on the image focal point, e.g. left_top if the subject is in the top-left corner.

body_line_height.title: Body Line Height
body_line_height.ai_description: Space between lines of body text. 1.4-1.5=standard comfortable reading. 1.6-1.8=airy, open feel (luxury, editorial). 1.2-1.3=compact, dense (dashboards, data-heavy). Higher values improve readability for long-form content.

body_font_size.title: Body Font Size
body_font_size.ai_description: Base font size for all body text in pixels. 14px=compact (traditional Drupal). 16px=modern web standard (recommended). 18px=large, accessible (editorial, luxury). 16px is the most widely recommended base size.

nav_font_size.title: Main menu Font Size
nav_font_size.ai_description: Font size for main menu links. 12-13px=small subtle nav. 14-15px=standard. 16-18px=prominent nav links. Usually similar to or slightly smaller than body_font_size.

headings_line_height.title: Headings Line Height
headings_line_height.ai_description: Line height for headings. 1.0-1.1=tight (good for large display headings). 1.2-1.3=standard heading spacing. 1.4+=loose. Tighter line-height looks better on larger headings, especially uppercase.

scale_factor.title: Typography Scale Factor
scale_factor.ai_description: Typographic scale ratio multiplied across heading sizes. 1.0=manual control (use individual h1-h4 sizes). 1.125=major second (subtle). 1.25=major third (balanced, most popular). 1.333=perfect fourth. 1.5=perfect fifth (dramatic). 1.618=golden ratio. When >1, overrides individual h1-h4 font sizes.

h1_font_size.title: H1 Font Size (Page Title)
h1_font_size.ai_description: Font size for H1 (page titles, main headings). 28-32px=modest. 36-42px=standard (default 36). 48-64px=large display. 72+px=hero statement. Only active when scale_factor=1.

h2_font_size.title: H2 Font Size
h2_font_size.ai_description: Font size for H2 (section headings). Usually 60-80% of h1. 20-24px=compact. 28-32px=standard. Should be clearly smaller than h1 but larger than h3.

h3_font_size.title: H3 Font Size
h3_font_size.ai_description: Font size for H3 (subsection headings). 16-18px=subtle. 20-24px=clear. Should be visually distinct from body text but smaller than h2.

h4_font_size.title: H4 Font Size
h4_font_size.ai_description: Font size for H4 (minor headings, labels). 12-14px=same as body (distinguished by weight). 16-18px=slightly larger. Often same size as body but bold.

blockquote_font_size.title: Blockquote Font Size
blockquote_font_size.ai_description: Font size for blockquotes/pullquotes. Usually larger than body to create emphasis. 16-18px=subtle emphasis. 20-24px=clear callout. 28+px=dramatic pullquote.

blockquote_line_height.title: Blockquote Line Height
blockquote_line_height.ai_description: Line height for blockquotes. 1.4-1.6=comfortable reading. Often slightly more generous than body_line_height since blockquotes are usually larger text.

headings_letter_spacing.title: Headings Letter Spacing
headings_letter_spacing.ai_description: Letter spacing (tracking) for headings in em units. 0=normal (default). 0.05-0.1em=slightly open (modern, clean). 0.15-0.2em=wide tracking (luxury, fashion). -0.02 to -0.05em=tight (heavy display headings). Wide tracking works best with uppercase headings.

headings_uppercase.title: Headings Uppercase
headings_uppercase.ai_description: Transform all headings to UPPERCASE. Creates a strong, authoritative look. Works well with wider headings_letter_spacing (0.05-0.1em). Common in corporate, fashion, and portfolio sites.

headings_bold.title: Headings Bold
headings_bold.ai_description: Force all headings to bold weight. Enable for strong visual hierarchy. Some heading fonts already include bold weights, making this redundant.

body_mobile_font_size.title: Body Font Size
body_mobile_font_size.ai_description: Body text size on mobile screens. Usually same as desktop (14-16px) or slightly larger for thumb-distance reading. Never go below 14px on mobile for accessibility.

nav_mobile_font_size.title: Nav Font Size
nav_mobile_font_size.ai_description: Navigation text size in the mobile hamburger menu. 14-16px=standard. 18-20px=large touch-friendly links.

h1_mobile_font_size.title: H1 Font Size (Page Title)
h1_mobile_font_size.ai_description: H1 size on mobile. Usually 60-80% of desktop h1 to fit small screens. 24-28px=compact. 32-36px=standard mobile heading.

h2_mobile_font_size.title: H2 Font Size
h2_mobile_font_size.ai_description: H2 size on mobile. Scale proportionally with h1_mobile_font_size.

h3_mobile_font_size.title: H3 Font Size
h3_mobile_font_size.ai_description: H3 size on mobile. Often same as desktop h3 since it is already relatively small.

h4_mobile_font_size.title: H4 Font Size
h4_mobile_font_size.ai_description: H4 size on mobile. Often same as desktop h4.

blockquote_mobile_font_size.title: Blockquote Font Size
blockquote_mobile_font_size.ai_description: Blockquote size on mobile. Can be slightly larger than desktop to maintain the pullquote emphasis effect on small screens.

divider_thickness.title: Divider Thickness
divider_thickness.ai_description: Height/thickness of horizontal rule dividers. 1-2px=hairline (subtle, elegant). 3-4px=standard (default 4). 6-8px=bold accent bar. 10+px=thick decorative band.

divider_length.title: Divider Length
divider_length.ai_description: Width of the divider line. 0=full width (spans entire container). 50-100px=short accent mark (modern, minimal). 200-300px=medium decorative line.

divider_position.title: Divider Position
divider_position.ai_description: Horizontal alignment when divider_length is not 0. 1=left aligned. 2=centered (most common for short dividers). 3=right aligned.

divider_color.title: Divider Color
divider_color.ai_description: Color of the divider line. Use a theme palette color name or custom with divider_color_custom. Often a subtle gray or the primary accent color.

divider_color_custom.title: Custom Value
divider_color_custom.ai_description: Custom hex color for divider. Only used when divider_color=custom. #eeeeee=very subtle light gray. Use brand accent color for decorative emphasis.
